descriptionByLocale.it:
• Responsabile del team Angiologia MPA/MPK 80%, a partire dal 1 luglio 2026 Candidati ora L'Ospedale Limmattal prospera grazie alla collaborazione interdisciplinare. I membri del team dell'amministrazione medica supportano la professione medica in tutte le questioni amministrative e lavorano anche a stretto contatto con l'assistenza infermieristica e tutte le altre aree. L’intera amministrazione medica è sotto un’unica direzione generale, che rafforza e semplifica ulteriormente la cooperazione interdisciplinare. In più: LIMMI è il posto giusto per te se per te è importante un'atmosfera familiare e un ambiente di lavoro moderno. Per rafforzare il nostro team di angiologia dedicato, stiamo cercando un team leader esperto e responsabile dell'MPA. In questo ruolo chiave assumerai la gestione tecnica e organizzativa della segreteria e fornirai un contributo significativo al buon funzionamento delle visite mediche specialistiche. Lavori a stretto contatto con la professione medica e l'amministrazione medica e sei la persona di contatto centrale per il tuo team. Puoi aspettarti un ambiente di lavoro diversificato con strutture chiare, orari di lavoro regolari e l'opportunità di contribuire attivamente con le tue capacità di leadership e organizzative. Orario di lavoro regolare dal lunedì al venerdì, senza turni notturni o festivi. Qui sarai coinvolto:
• nella gestione del team della segreteria con 3 AMP^
• nella pianificazione del regolare svolgimento delle consultazioni mediche specialistiche
• in stretta collaborazione con l'assistente amministrativo medico
• nell'assistenza ai pazienti prima, durante e dopo gli esami
• in diversi lavori amministrativi, compresa la rendicontazione

• nel supporto diretto della professione medica

descriptionByLocale.en:
• Team leader MPA/MPK Angiology 80%, as of July 1st, 2026 Apply now The Limmattal Hospital thrives on interdisciplinary collaboration. The medical administration team members support the medical profession in all administrative matters and also work closely with nursing and all other areas. The entire medical administration is under one overall management, which further strengthens and simplifies interdisciplinary cooperation. In addition: LIMMI is the right place for you if a family atmosphere and a modern workplace are important to you. To strengthen our dedicated angiology team, we are looking for an experienced and responsible MPA team leader. In this key role, you will take on the technical and organizational management of the secretariat and make a significant contribution to the smooth running of specialist medical consultations. You work closely with the medical profession and the medical administration and are the central contact person for your team. You can expect a diverse working environment with clear structures, regular working hours and the opportunity to actively contribute your leadership and organizational skills. Regular working hours from Monday to Friday, with no night or weekend shifts. Here you will be involved:
• in the team management of the secretariat with 3 MPA^s
• in the planning of a smooth running of specialist medical consultations
• in close cooperation with the medical administration assistant
• in patient care before, during and after the examinations
• in various administrative work including reporting
• in the independent implementation of technical examinations and assistance with specialist medical treatments, especially outpatient varicose vein operations
• in the direct support of the medical profession
• have a completed professional training as a medical practice assistant EFZ
• already have initial management experience - this would be an advantage
• enjoy writing medical reports
• feel confident in daily patient contact
• enjoy working in the background just as much as at the front
• are a committed and pleasant personality
• have good PC skills
• already have KISIM experience - this would be an advantage
• have a reliable and careful way of working
• have excellent organizational skills
• discounted employee parking spaces
• motorcycle parking spaces, Lockable bicycle parking spaces
• With the ZVV-Bonus Pass / Z-Bonus Pass, we offer an attractive public transport subscription for employees

• Chef d'équipe MPA/MPK Angiologie 80%, à compter du 1er juillet 2026 Postulez maintenant L'hôpital Limmattal prospère grâce à la collaboration interdisciplinaire. Les membres de l'équipe de l'administration médicale soutiennent la profession médicale dans toutes les questions administratives et travaillent également en étroite collaboration avec les soins infirmiers et dans tous les autres domaines. L'ensemble de l'administration médicale est sous une direction globale, ce qui renforce et simplifie encore la coopération interdisciplinaire. De plus : LIMMI est l'endroit idéal pour vous si une ambiance familiale et un lieu de travail moderne sont importants pour vous. Pour renforcer notre équipe dédiée à l'angiologie, nous recherchons un chef d'équipe MPA expérimenté et responsable. Dans ce rôle clé, vous assumerez la gestion technique et organisationnelle du secrétariat et apporterez une contribution significative au bon déroulement des consultations médicales spécialisées. Vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement de travail diversifié avec des structures claires, des horaires de travail réguliers et la possibilité d'apporter activement votre leadership et vos compétences organisationnelles.
